# Safeplane model-gateway import

Source repository: https://github.com/stefanrossmeier/safeplane
Source path: `services/model-gateway`
License: Apache-2.0 (root Safeplane license at the time of the supplied snapshot)
Import date: 2026-09-24

The repository snapshot supplied for this implementation contained the copied service but did not retain the Safeplane commit SHA. Recover and record the exact source SHA before a public Wikiplane release. The copied service has been adapted into a generic OpenAI-compatible Wikiplane model gateway; Wikiplane core/application code depends only on `ModelProvider`.
